t: This is Mare Street, in the London Borough of Hackney. It has existed since the fifteenth century, when it was one of the first roads at the centre of the parish, and was then called Merestret. The name may come from an Old English word for a boundary, or from a large pond. Cornelius Varley was born here. He was a watercolour painter and instrument-maker who invented the graphic telescope and the graphic microscope.
